mapper.sql: select t.topic_id, t.activity_id, t.venue_id, t.topic_name, t.start_time, t.end_time, t.chair_names, t.host_names, t.discuss_names, t.sort_order, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, v.venue_name, (select count(1) from yc_schedule s where s.topic_id=t.topic_id and s.del_flag='0') as schedule_count from yc_topic t left join yc_venue v on v.venue_id=t.venue_id and v.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, (select count(1) from yc_schedule s where s.activity_id=#{activityId} and s.del_flag='0') as scheduleCount from yc_topic where activity_id=#{activityId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.delete: update yc_topic set del_flag='2' where topic_id in #{id}
